title: the persistent plugin package is loadable in shape: declared paths exist, both ESM halves are plain modules, the bundle registers itself with seed-only requires, and the inserted row is the disabled one
titleZh: 常驻插件包的形状可加载:声明路径存在、两个 ESM 半边是普通模块、bundle 自注册且只 require 平台 seed、insert 行默认 disabled
why: The persistent plugin face (plugin/) is the one component in this repository that an operator installs into a real DSH profile, and a wrong entry there is expensive: a client entry that cannot load leaves the whole GUI in recovery mode (the measured incident recorded in the local AGENTS.md). This case therefore asserts the SHAPE statically and offline, before anyone enables the row: (a) package.json declares type=module, main, exports['./client'] and dsh.bundle.patch, and every one of those targets exists; (b) the two ESM halves contain no require( call at all, while the browser bundle registers itself via window.__ModuleLoader__.load with the package name and requires nothing except the platform seed react - measured against dsh-client-modules/lib/client.js (a fetched bundle that fails to register throws, and the synchronous require only resolves seed words or already-materialized rows); (c) no JSX and no TypeScript-only syntax anywhere in the script surface, because neither is transformed at load time; (d) the cordis.patch.yml row carries id and name equal to the package name and ships disabled, which is what makes the phase-1 skeleton inert. The panel/plugin-preflight.ps1 script asserts the same facts at runtime with more detail (including byte-identity of the shared client body); this case keeps the same property checkable by the suite on any clone.
inject: the plugin package (plugin/package.json, plugin/cordis.patch.yml, plugin/lib/*.js), docs/install/plugin-package.md and the preflight script, checked for the declared-path, module-shape and disabled-row facts
expectSummary: package.json declares module/main/exports[./client]/bundle.patch and each target exists; require( appears only in plugin/lib/client.js (seed react); no JSX, no TypeScript syntax; the insert row has id==name==package.json name and disabled: true; the doc carries the paste-ready commands and the three-step/four-step headings
